name: hide_cinematic_bars

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_HideCinematicBars takes no Script context and does not access the value stack

notes: ScriptCommand_HideCinematicBars starts func_00104310 with a fixed two-tick transition and clears persistent event-state bit 0x1. func_00104310 schedules func_00104290, which increases the cinematic-bar transition value until it reaches the configured limit, then disables the GS packet that draws the black full-width sprites. This is the inverse of command 139 show_cinematic_bars. The JP corpus contains 11 calls across six archives; nine follow command 139 in the same script entry.
